summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ does node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs, inherited by _RDFNamespace. The RDFS/SKOS-style IPython completion hook now returns dir(self.uri). NamespaceManager was left unchanged. Added tests to test/test_namespace.py covering prefix positive/negative/self cases, SH, RDFS closed positive/negative plus plain-string and Literal negatives, and RDF closed positive plus the rdf:_1 container negative. Tests were not run (per instructions); the changes were verified by reading only. Nothing was committed.
